valid_fixes: Restore RequestStateHandlerFunction.Properties.Environment.Variables.FRIEND_TABLE to !Ref FriendTable so the handler writes the receiver-side Pending record to the correct DynamoDB table
invalid_patches: Change FRIEND_TABLE to the literal stack-resolved table name (e.g. ace-bench-stack-friend) as a hardcoded string — functionally works but is fragile and not idiomatic CloudFormation
Add a second DynamoDB table named Friend-nonexistent — creates an unintended resource rather than fixing the misconfiguration
optimal_diagnostic_path: ace_get_trace_summaries(window_minutes=30) → lists recent traces; RequestStateHandlerFunction traces are present

ace_get_trace(trace_id=<RequestStateHandler trace id>) → shows the RequestStateHandlerFunction segment containing a DynamoDB PutItem subsegment with error=true, fault=true, http_status=400, pinpointing the failing downstream call; cross-reference with ace_get_environment_variables(function=RequestStateHandlerFunction) to confirm FRIEND_TABLE=Friend-nonexistent points to a nonexistent table
observable_symptom: After a Request action, the receiver-side Pending record is never written to DynamoDB. The pending_record_created assertion fails: wait_for_state(table, friend_id, player_id, Pending) times out. RequestStateHandlerFunction is invoked (stream event triggers it) but its downstream PutItem call raises ResourceNotFoundException against a nonexistent table.
root_cause: RequestStateHandlerFunction.Properties.Environment.Variables.FRIEND_TABLE is set to the literal string 'Friend-nonexistent' instead of !Ref FriendTable. The handler reads this env var at cold-start to create a DynamoDB resource handle pointing to a table that does not exist. Every PutItem call in _create_pending() raises ResourceNotFoundException, which is caught and re-raised (since it is not a ConditionalCheckFailedException), causing the handler to return a batchItemFailures list. The X-Ray trace captures the failed PutItem as a faulted subsegment (error=true, fault=true, http_status=400), pinpointing the wrong table name via ace_get_environment_variables.
